title: Unit Event — Aim Higher and Higher! — Episode6 Anticipation

meta.Event Outline: The day of Taiga and Ken's event has finally arrived. The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD are looking forward to this world-class event, when an incident leads to an unexpected reunion.

rows.Line: SONIC NOTES

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, this place is so big...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So this is where SONIC NOTES is happening...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nothing has started yet, but the sheer size of this place is overwhelming...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The size is one thing, but also...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
“I'm so excited!
UPsetter's up first! I'm a huge fan!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Man, how often do you get to see this sort of legendary lineup?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
There's a ton of people.
And more just keep coming in!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: This place can apparently hold over 80,000 people!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: If you include the substage with the big screen, then that number goes above 100,000, probably.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Th-That's so many people. I can't even really picture it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And that many people are gathering here, for one purpose... It's overwhelming.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't understand what they're saying, but I hear people speaking in languages other than English.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is so incredible.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Taiga and An's dad are going to perform in front of all these people.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're going to sing for a global audience...!
se_walk_men_002_4

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Hey, wait a second! You guys are Embers!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “What are you two doing down here? You guys should be up there!”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: “Haha. You called over to us just to pick a fight?”

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
“We're still down here for now...
But we'll be standing on that stage someday.”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
“That's big talk.
Well, looking forward to it. You two aren't bad, after all!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think they're fans of Slade and Cedric.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, I didn't realize that those two were so famous over here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They should be, considering how good they are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still haven't heard Cedric sing yet, but he has to be amazing if he's partnered up with Slade.
<Hey!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: <Is it okay for us to pop out right now?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: <We wanna see what the stage is like!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Everyone seems to be focused on Slade and Cedric right now, so you two should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa! Is this the place?!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Wow...!
And is that the main stage?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<It's sooo big!
I've never seen one that size!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <And Taiga and An's father are going to sing here. That's incredible.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. You guys are saying the same things we did when we got here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to hearing them sing.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everything about this has been overwhelming... But this event is the whole reason we came to the United States to begin with.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I need to keep my eyes and ears open so that I'm able to absorb as much information as I can!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa's absolutely right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're about to watch world-class artists perform. We have to learn as much as we can from them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Despite being a part of the audience today, they sound as motivated as ever.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I hope this event ends up being a good learning experience for them.>

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Oh, the first group's on?!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
“The first block is mostly rock, right?
They should be on around...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
It's begun!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
“We're UPsetter.
Are you guys all ready?!”

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: “It's time to get SONIC NOTES on the road!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This cheering... It feels like an earthquake...! They're making the entire venue shake!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Seriously? All this, for the start of the very first song?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But... What's more impressive is...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The way they're singing...! I can't keep my body still!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Everyone's so excited...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The event's just begun, but they're all bouncing off the walls.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is so incredible...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see how the rest of this event is going to unfold!)
